description: This header file defines classes and interfaces for HDMI CEC (Consumer Electronics Control) management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes class declarations for CEC device information, the main HdmiCec plugin class, and related methods for device management, message processing, and event handling.

classes.name: CECDeviceInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a CEC device, including logical address, vendor ID, OSD name, and status flags.

classes.name: HdmiCec
classes.description: Main plugin class managing HDMI CEC functionalities, device list, message processing, and event handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to enable or disable CEC functionality based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve current CEC enable status.

methods.name: getCECAddressesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to get CEC device addresses.

methods.name: sendMessageWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to send a CEC message.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of connected CEC devices.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of the active source.
